prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Make the one final targeted revision of this established 74:100 fantasy RPG pixel PORTRAIT.
Image 1 is the first portrait to revise. Image 2 is the historical identity reference only, not its chibi style. Images 3-5 are Mara/Leiya/Tore STYLE and tight face-framing references, never identity replacements.
Preserve character, sex, age, costume colors, warm muted palette, three-quarter left pose and truly transparent background. Deliver ONE portrait only. No text, border, torso, props or extra people.
Recompose in the same tall 74:100 frame: VERY LARGE FACE with crown near top but complete, chin/beard ends at about 88% height. Bare neck now only a short bridge, collar only a narrow bottom strip. All visible-side hair/headscarf and ears fully enclosed inside at least a 3% transparent border left and right. Shrink the hair's outward volume rather than shrinking the face to fit. No stretching or skinny long face. Strong coarse connected pixel planes and crisp stepped edges, no gradients, no dithering, no noise, no antialiasing or tiny isolated speckles. Small dark eyes with minimal dark-beige sclera; no white glowing eyes.
Specific correction: Doro is a FORTY-year-old woman with rounded full cheeks. The first portrait looks too gaunt and old. Shorten and broaden the lower face, restore full cheeks and a compact mature jaw, soften the heavy nasolabial furrows into one modest cheek plane. Maintain subtle tired blue-gray shadows under eyes and a little age at outer eyes, not deep elderly wrinkles. Flatten the raised inner brow ends and keep her closed mouth nearly horizontal with a faint restrained asymmetry, the expression of a tired capable caregiver after a brief polite smile fades; NOT worried pleading, tragic or tearful. Major correction: remove most bare neck and collar height; head is larger, not a bust. Retain chestnut hair, a tight mustard/ochre-brown headscarf with compact rear knot, narrow olive-green neckline and ochre apron band. Consolidate the dangling temple curls into attached broad hair shapes; no thin loose strands. Keep full headscarf and side contours enclosed, both edges with transparent margin.
